Package model

Class Manager

java.lang.Object
model.User
model.Employee
model.Manager
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class Manager extends Employee implements Serializable
Represents a manager in the university system. Extends Employee with administrative capabilities: course management, student registration approval, teacher assignment, complaint handling, and news broadcasting.

Implements the Observer pattern — the manager acts as publisher, Employee instances act as subscribers.

  • Method Details

    • subscribe

      public void subscribe(Employee e)
      Subscribes an Employee to receive news notifications. Duplicate entries are silently ignored.
      Parameters:
      e - the employee to subscribe; must not be null

    • unsubscribe

      public void unsubscribe(Employee e)
      Unsubscribes an Employee from news notifications. Does nothing if the employee is not subscribed.
      Parameters:
      e - the employee to unsubscribe

    • publishNews

      public void publishNews(String newsItem)
      Broadcasts a news item to all subscribed employees. Stores the item internally, prints it to standard output, and delivers a Message to every subscriber.
      Parameters:
      newsItem - the news text to broadcast; must not be null

    • addCourseForRegistration

      public void addCourseForRegistration(Course course)
      Opens a course for student registration and adds it to the managed-course list. If the course is already tracked, it is not added again.
      Parameters:
      course - the course to open for registration; must not be null

    • approveRegistration

      public boolean approveRegistration(Student student, Course course)
      Approves a student's pending registration request for a course. The student must have an existing pending request for the given course. On success, confirms enrollment on the student's side and adds the student to the course roster.
      Parameters:
      student - the student whose request to approve; must not be null
      course - the course being registered; must not be null
      Returns:
      true if registration was approved; false if no pending request exists

    • assignTeacher

      public void assignTeacher(Course course, Teacher teacher)
      Assigns a teacher to a course and prints a confirmation message. Callers are responsible for updating any additional teacher-course relationships outside this method.
      Parameters:
      course - the course to assign the teacher to
      teacher - the teacher being assigned
